title: Ultimate Admin Toolbox
description: This Modd Adds Admin Toolbox and Troll GUI
body:
Ultimate Admin Toolbox is a comprehensive, all-in-one administration utility designed for server owners and administrators. This mod provides a high-performance, seamless experience for managing your server, keeping an eye on players, and maintaining order through advanced trolling capabilities.

🚀 Key Features:
AAA Vanish System: Become completely invisible to other players, leave the game silently (fake disconnect message), and gain creative flight capabilities without leaving a trace.

Advanced Troll GUI: Access a fully interactive, inventory-style GUI by simply typing /troll. Manage, monitor, and prank players with ease.

50+ Unique Troll Actions: Choose from a wide variety of tools, including:

Mob & Physics Manipulation: Summon creepers, wolves, or launch players into the void.

Environmental Trolling: Create obsidian/glass/bedrock traps, summon lightning, or trigger TNT explosions.

Inventory & Status Effects: Clear inventories, reset hunger, apply nausea, blindness, or extreme movement speed.

Fake Messages: Trigger fake OP messages, fake ban alerts, or custom death messages to keep your server dynamic.

Intuitive UI: Hover over items in the Troll Menu to see exact descriptions of what each action does.

Operator Security: All features are restricted to server operators (OP), ensuring that only authorized users can use the toolkit.

🛠 Technical Specifications:
Minecraft Version: 1.21.1

Mod Loader: Forge

Synchronized Design: Built with a hybrid server-client architecture to ensure smooth packet synchronization and instant action execution.

📜 Installation Instructions:
For Servers: Install this mod into your server's mods folder. Ensure you have the same Forge version installed on your server.

For Clients: Players must also have this mod installed on their clients to ensure all GUI elements, textures, and sounds work perfectly.

Permissions: Ensure you are OP on the server to access the /troll and /vanish commands.

⚠️ Disclaimer:
This mod is intended for administrative purposes on private or personal servers. Please use it responsibly and ensure you have permission to manage the players on your server.

Elevate your server management experience today with Ultimate Admin Toolbox!
